parameters.query: SELECT DATE(fecha_hora) as fecha, COUNT(*) as total_triajes, SUM(CASE WHEN nivel_urgencia = 'crítico' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as criticos, SUM(CASE WHEN nivel_urgencia = 'alto' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as altos, SUM(CASE WHEN nivel_urgencia = 'moderado' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as moderados, SUM(CASE WHEN nivel_urgencia = 'bajo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as bajos FROM triajes WHERE fecha_hora::date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY fecha
